sentences.en: The magnets, of course, have a magnetic field around them.
sentences.zh: 当然，磁铁周围有一个磁场。

sentences.en: Charles Walcot investigated the magnetic compass bearing sense in pigeons.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·瓦洛特研究了鸽子的磁性罗盘定向能力。

sentences.en: They were drawn to each other by a magnetic attraction.
sentences.zh: 他们被一种磁性的吸引力吸引到一起。

senses.zh: 有磁性的，磁的；有吸引力的，有魅力的；磁性的，磁力的
